description: This file contains functions related to the upgrade process for Zyxel devices, specifically handling environment checks, partition management, and upgrade preparation routines.

methods.name: zyxel_mstc_prepare_fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message, unmounts all filesystems, and reboots the device upon failure during environment preparation.

methods.name: zyxel_mstc_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the device for upgrade, checks partition info, and sets environment variables related to boot configuration.
